gloss: to turn pages; to leaf through

definitions.gloss: to turn pages; to leaf through; to flip through
definitions.explanation: To turn the pages of a book, magazine, or document. The verb 繰る means to turn or draw something through one's hands, giving a sense of moving through pages one by one.

examples.japanese: ページを{繰|く}って⟦{目次|もくじ}→目次：00288_mokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}した→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I flipped through the pages looking for the table of contents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦アルバム→アルバム：03831_arubamu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦{繰|く}った→繰る：30725_kuru⟧。
examples.english: I slowly turned the pages of the old photo album.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夢中|むちゅう}→夢中：03752_muchuu⟧になって⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ページを{繰|く}り⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
examples.english: I was so absorbed that I kept turning page after page.

notes:
USAGE:
A slightly literary expression. In everyday speech, ⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧めくる is more common. ⟦{繰|く}る→繰る：30725_kuru⟧ has a sense of drawing or reeling something through, giving this phrase a more deliberate, contemplative feel.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ページを{繰|く}る⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらない→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧ (can't stop turning pages)
- ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{繰|く}る→繰る：30725_kuru⟧ (to turn one page at a time)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧めくる: to turn pages — more common in everyday speech
- ⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to open a page — for opening to a specific page
- パラパラめくる: to flip through quickly — casual, browsing
